name: Harness memory recall
description: Recalls what this deployment remembers and prepends its structure to a turn's context.

read.title: Reader argv
read.description: The reader to spawn, as argv, up to and including the `bundle` subcommand. Written by harnesses/openclaw/install-memory.sh. An argv that is empty, or that names a read shape other than `bundle`, recalls nothing and says so in the log rather than injecting silence.

timeoutMs.title: Recall budget (ms)
timeoutMs.description: How long the whole lookup gets. It sits in front of a reply, so a slow read is a slow conversation: when it runs out the turn proceeds with no recalled context.

maxRecords.title: Records injected
maxRecords.description: Most records one turn may carry. Also the reader's `--limit`, so a turn that wants eight records is charged for eight rather than for the service's cap.

maxChars.title: Characters injected
maxChars.description: Ceiling on the rendered block. Whatever it cuts is counted in the block, because a truncated list that reads as complete is worse than a short one.
